AN ORDINANCE AMENDING
ORDINANCE NO. 225 OF THE CITY
OF MARION, ARKANSAS (THE
"CITY"), AS AMENDED BY
ORDINANCE NO. 633 OF THE CITY,
IN ORDER TO CHANGE THE
DESIGNATED USES OF THE
HOTEL/MOTEL GROSS RECEIPTS
TAX (THE "LODGING TAX") AND THE
RESTAURANT GROSS RECEIPTS
TAX (COLLECTIVELY, THE "A&P
TAXES") LEVIED BY THE CITY; TO
AUTHORIZE COLLECTIONS OF THE
A&P TAXES TO BE PLEDGED TO
BONDS APPROVED BY THE
VOTERS AND ISSUED FROM TIME
TO TIME BY THE CITY TO FINANCE
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENTS
AUTHORIZED TO BE FINANCED
UNDER TITLE 26, CHAPTER 75,
SUBCHAPTER 6 OF THE ARKANSAS
CODE OF 1987 ANNOTATED, AS
AMENDED FROM TIME TO TIME
(THE "AUTHORIZING
LEGISLATION"); TO AUTHORIZE
COLLECTIONS OF THE A&P TAXES
NOT NEEDED TO PAY DEBT
SERVICE ON BONDS TO BE USED
BY THE CITY ADVERTISING AND
PROMOTION COMMISSION FOR ALL
PURPOSES AS ARE PERMITTED BY
THE AUTHORIZING LEGISLATION;
TO EXPAND THE CATEGORIES OF
BUSINESSES SUBJECT TO THE A&P
TAXES TO ALL CATEGORIES SET
FORTH IN THE AUTHORIZING
LEGISLATION; TO INCREASE THE
LODGING TAX ON MEETING AND
PARTY ROOM FACILITIES TO 3%;
AND PRESCRIBING OTHER
MATTERS RELATING THERETO

excerpt:
Bonds of the City of Marion in one or
more series in the maximum aggregate
principal amount of $8,500,000 to
finance all or a portion of the costs of
certain capital improvements, including
particularly, without limitation,
improvements at Brunetti Park and at
the Marion Recreation Complex and
any necessary land acquisition,
furnishings, equipment and parking,
lighting, landscaping, street, drainage
and utility improvements related
thereto. The bonds will be payable from
a pledge of collections of the tax levied
by the City upon the gross receipts or
gross proceeds from the lodging
activities described in Arkansas Code
Annotated Section 26-75-602(c)(1)(A),
as it may be amended from time to
time, which currently include renting,
leasing or furnishing hotel, motel,
house, cabin, bed and breakfast,
campground, condominium or other
similar rental accommodations for
sleeping, meeting, or party room
facilities for profit in the City at the rate
of 3% and upon the gross receipts or
gross proceeds received from the food
service activities described in Arkansas
Code Annotated Section 26-75-
602(c)(2)(A), as it may be amended
from time to time, which currently
include the sale of prepared food and
beverages for on-premises or
off-premises consumption by
restaurants, cafes, cafeterias,
delicatessens, drive-in restaurants,
carry-out restaurants, concession
stands, convenience stores, grocery
store restaurants or similar businesses
within the City at the rate of 1%.
